name: @dsh-external/dsh-mode-group
description: DSH web client plugin: two-tier agent-preset picker on the new-session screen — built-ins and the researcher entry stay top-level while the eight professional security modes fold into a hover/click submenu, viewport-adaptive, with no other surface touched. v1.0.1 dual-host adaptation: the preset read/write surface is resolved at runtime (remote.agentPresets on hosts 0.1.2+, the legacy connection.api surface on older hosts) instead of a hard inject, so older hosts no longer stall web boot with a pending entry; when neither surface exists the plugin deactivates transparently and keeps the native picker.
author: SeaOf0
